headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to speed up infrastructure projects to help the economy recover from the COVID-19 emergency.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order tells federal agencies to move faster on infrastructure investments and related activities. Its stated goal is to help the U.S. economy recover from the COVID-19 emergency. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, programs, and rules involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that approve or fund infrastructure projects
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to speed up their work on infrastructure investments and related activities.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and governments building infrastructure projects
who_it_affects.how: Their projects may move through federal steps more quickly.
